items.html: *And the matter is that the days of the Yenika are twenty-four months. And it is because three Sefirot remain to be clarified, and they are: Hod, Yesod, Malchut. And you already know that a woman, after she has given birth, has a flow of blood. And the matter is that we have already explained that within the womb of the woman the fetus is clarified, and in the course of the days of the Ibur they are clarified little by little, until at the end of the days of the Ibur it is found that it has finished being clarified; and everything that could be clarified was clarified, and from it the body of the fetus was made.
